title: Tabs
description: Tabbed panels — horizontal, vertical, pill, and underlined orientations.

tool.name: mount_tabs
tool.description: Mount a Tabs component on the canvas. Use when the user asks for tabbed navigation, switchable panels, or content split across labeled views.

parameters.items: Array<{ label: string, content?: string }> — at least 2 items

orientation.desc: Layout axis for the tab strip

position.desc: Strip placement relative to the panel (top/left when before, bottom/right when after — depends on orientation)

align.desc: Alignment of tabs along the strip

props.name: items
props.desc: Tab items — strings or objects with label/value

props.name: fields
props.desc: Field mapping for label/value extraction from object items

props.name: orientation
props.desc: Layout axis of the tab strip

props.name: position
props.desc: Strip placement relative to the panel — `before` puts it top (horizontal) or left (vertical); `after` puts it bottom/right

props.name: align
props.desc: Alignment of tabs within the strip

props.name: placeholder
props.desc: Text shown when no tab is selected

events.name: onselect
events.desc: Fires when a tab is selected

events.name: onchange
events.desc: Fires when the selected tab changes

events.name: onmove
events.desc: Fires when focus moves between tabs

events.name: onadd
events.desc: Fires when add button is clicked (editable mode)

events.name: onremove
events.desc: Fires when a tab is removed (editable mode)
